title: Characterization of multi-way binary tables with uniform margins and fixed correlations
summary: In many applications involving binary variables, only pairwise dependence measures, such as correlations, are available. However, for multi-way tables involving more than two variables, these quantities do not uniquely determine the joint distribution, but instead define a family of admissible distributions that share the same pairwise dependence while potentially differing in higher-order interactions.
